name: boot_version
title: the unit is up: version, app on the Pattern screen, LEDs online, a screen that is not blank, nothing FAILED in the log

steps.note: OS-OUTON: the outputs open once at boot, after the project load (so no click on Play); the first Play, live note or Song Play never waits. SOFT: the boot lines live in the log ring, and about 20 minutes after boot newer lines push 'outputs open' out of it (`log` shows at most the last 48). A failure here on a unit that has been up for a while is NOT a fault: power-cycle the unit (the runner may not send `reset`) and run boot_version again for a conclusive result

(the boot log of this run; a line with FAILED or a fault is the thing to look at. The `audio: outputs open ... faults N` line is left out: its counters are the audio path's history, which the open gate tolerates by design (OS-007g), not a fault of this run)
